This disparity exists not just between developed and developing nations, but also within countries across different socio-economic groups. Access is not merely about owning a device, but also about the ability to use the internet effectively, which requires digital literacy and affordable connectivity. In an increasingly digital world, a lack of access can significantly restrict opportunities in education, employment, and civic participation.
